title: Five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport
content: Video showed thick smoke rising from the plane crash of the Boeing 767 that the Federal Aviation Administration says overran the airport runway in Miami.

title: German exit polls suggest far-right party has big lead in regional election
content: Exit polls show Germany's AfD taking a commanding lead in a regional election, but it remains unclear whether the far-right party can form the country's first state government since World War II.

title: American Muslims are giving Texas barbecue a halal makeover
content: Even as anti-Muslim rhetoric rises in Texas, Muslim pitmasters are winning over diners and reshaping one of the state's most iconic culinary traditions.

title: Witkoff and Kushner call Kyiv talks 'substantive' after Moscow Putin meeting
content: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held meetings in Kyiv with Ukraine's President Zelenskyy on Sunday, a day after lengthy conversations with Russian President Putin in Moscow.

title: QUIZ: Ugh, I'll do it later. How much do you know about procrastination?
content: Learn a few surprising facts about procrastination — and helpful tools to overcome it — with this quiz. It's based on social scientist Itamar Shatz's new book, Solving Procrastination.

title: Whatever happened to kindness? Spoiler alert: Our readers prove it's alive and well
content: We asked readers to share stories about a moment of kindness involving a stranger. Here are some of their heartwarming anecdotes.

title: Jazz legend John Coltrane's Philadelphia house to become a cultural heritage site
content: On the centennial of father's birth, Ravi Coltrane talks about turning the home where the jazz legend spent a crucial period in the 1950s into a cultural heritage and community space.
